system.description:
MENTAL MYRATHI

The distinction between speech, emotion and chemical signal has become increasingly unimportant to you.
Creatures connected to you through Whisper Network may communicate with one another through you while each remains within 60 feet of you, even if they are not Myrathi.
In addition, while connected, you can convey simple emotional impressions - danger, calm, urgency, uncertainty, approval or warning - even when you do not share a language. This does not permit detailed communication without a shared language.

Prerequisites Nethri growth, Whisper Network, Level 5

A rule for the table: Whisper Network's connected creatures may speak through you, and simple emotional impressions cross a language gap.
